sources: The Wall Street Journal (via The Times); Trump remarks to reporters Thursday
fault_line: Meme-frame: 'Should slowing Starlink be considered a war crime?' (1.8K likes/370 comments FB) vs 'America owes Ukraine nothing' -- the civilian-leverage question is the fault line.

sections.what_happened: WSJ reported Trump pressured Elon Musk to restore Ukraine's access to Starlink after a brief pause widely seen as pressure on Kyiv over Moscow's territorial demands. Trump refused to confirm the report on Thursday; hours after Zelensky claimed Starlink speeds were still lagging, Trump said service had been restored: 'Bottom line, he put it back.'
sections.what_verified: The pressure claim is WSJ-anonymous-sourcing only; the restoration is Trump on-record. Zelensky's lag claim vs Trump's restored claim conflict on current state.
sections.what_disputed: Trump would neither confirm nor deny the pressure report; no independent verification of the pressure call.
sections.why_matters: A private tech CEO holds a lever on a country's drone defence and the US president personally lobbied him -- frame as the Starlink dependency, not the palace intrigue.
sections.context: Background: NEW -- WSJ: Trump pressured Musk to restore Ukraine Starlink; Trump refuses to confirm but says 'bottom line, he put it back'
